source_vintage: DOE 2021 IECC residential HP prototype outputs; output tables generated 2024-06-27 / posted 2024-12-22; embodied study published 2024-12-15
geography: Pittsburgh (Allegheny County) IECC climate-zone proxy 5A; DOE weather model is Buffalo NY TMY3

detached.proxy_label: DOE 2021 IECC single-family detached; direct form match

embodied_kgco2e_psf.geography: Theoretical US DOE single-family detached prototype; 16 IECC climate zones and four foundation types; not Pittsburgh-specific.
embodied_kgco2e_psf.reported_stage_boundary: A1-A3 product-stage embodied GHG; gross ECI, without applying separately reported theoretical maximum biogenic storage
embodied_kgco2e_psf.physical_scope: DOE single-family prototype quantity takeoff: structure, enclosure, and foundation material classes
embodied_kgco2e_psf.center_basis: Arithmetic midpoint of the published 39–121 kgCO2e/m2 all-model ECI range (80 kgCO2e/m2 converted to 7.43 kgCO2e/sf); declared planning center, not a reported sample mean.

proxy_adjustment.limitations: Detached house maps to the DOE single-family detached form.

embodied_kgco2e_psf.limitations: Upfront materials (A1-A3 proxy), not complete whole-building or whole-life carbon. The source covers DOE detached single-family models and structure/enclosure/foundation material classes; interiors/fit-out, MEP, appliances and sitework are not established as included. A4-A5 transport/construction, replacements/use and end-of-life are outside A1-A3. Source min/max spans study climate, foundation, and LCA-tool cases, not a confidence interval. Typology differences beyond the DOE detached archetype use declared proxy factors.

operational_kwh_psf_yr.geography: IECC 2021 climate zone 5A; DOE uses Buffalo Niagara International Airport TMY3; Allegheny County is also CZ5A but Buffalo weather is not Pittsburgh local weather
operational_kwh_psf_yr.scenario: All-electric heat-pump scenario. Uses only DOE hp-tagged output tables; all non-electric fuel columns in selected annual end-use outputs are zero.
operational_kwh_psf_yr.end_uses: Electricity:Facility annual meter for all modeled end uses, normalized by Net Conditioned Building Area.
operational_kwh_psf_yr.center_basis: Arithmetic mean of the four DOE HP foundation variant EUIs for the selected prototype; no building-form savings are assumed.

proxy_adjustment.limitations: Detached house maps to the DOE single-family detached form.

operational_kwh_psf_yr.limitations: Simulated 2021 IECC prototype electricity in Buffalo TMY3 weather, not a Pittsburgh meter or prediction. Assumes all-electric heat-pump systems; selected output tables have zero non-electric fuel use. Foundation low/high span four foundation variants only and are not a statistical interval. Building form, floor area, occupancy, schedules, appliance behavior and local weather may differ. DOE uses one single-family detached and one multifamily low-rise base form; other forms are explicit proxies.
